body.text: First-party public APIs expose Milo A1 at $975, an active through-2026-08-31 maximum of eight weeks free plus app/admin waiver and look-and-lease language, and dog costs. They expose no lease terms or public unit numbers; the two A1 rows carry past 2025 availability dates while the floorplan says in stock. Preserved as a reconciliation, not an averaged availability or guaranteed concession.

subject: Milo direct quote surface exposes a promotion but not a quote curve
